title: CreatorShield AI: AI risk checks for creators — before you publish | Product Hunt
excerpt: CreatorShield AI scans your POD designs, book covers, and video thumbnails for trademark, copyright, and marketplace-policy risks before you publish — across 7 risk lenses. No account needed, results in under a minute. Built by a solo POD seller who got tired of losing designs to takedowns — now open to self-publishers and YouTubers too.

content_html_zh: CreatorShield AI 在您发布之前扫描您的 POD 设计、书籍封面和视频缩略图，以查找商标、版权和市场政策风险 - 涵盖 7 个风险镜头。 无需帐户，不到一分钟即可获得结果。 由一位 POD 独立卖家创建，他厌倦了因被下架而失去设计——现在也向自助出版商和 YouTube 用户开放。
